summary: Two index.json points to confirm: the Frog-Footman's faction/livery, and 'unspecified' gender on the ensemble entries, which the appearance cards now fix to concrete values.

source.quote: It was opened by another footman in livery, with a round face
“For the Duchess. An invitation from the Queen to play croquet.”

findings.issue: The source says the Frog-Footman opens the Duchess's door and receives the Queen's invitation on her behalf, so he reads as the Duchess's servant (FAC-duchess-household). The source never names the livery, so this is a question for arbitration, not an outright conflict.
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm FAC-house-of-hearts, or re-point him to FAC-duchess-household. If re-pointed, his livery becomes the Duchess household's plainer, faded look (see FAC-duchess-household emblem_visual) instead of Hearts crimson.
findings.interim_handling: The appearance card follows the controlled index (crimson Hearts livery, matching CHAR-fish-footman). A ruling would change only the coat colour and badge.

findings.issue: Under the 2026-07-20 appearance rule, gender must be male or female, never blank or unspecified. The appearance cards set concrete values plus a gender_mix breakdown. Jury is all male, sourced from 'jury-men' (ch011-p04). Soldiers, gardeners and court officers are all male (inferred). The Caucus remainder, visiting monarchs, procession and crowd are mixed, with the split given in gender_mix.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the index gender for these entries to match the appearance cards, or add a gender_mix note.

impact: Voice casting (voiceprint) and image generation read gender from the appearance cards, so these points don't block that work. The index should be brought in line for G3 consistency.
ruling: (a) Ruled: re-point CHAR-frog-footman to FAC-duchess-household. The source has him open the Duchess's door and receive the Queen's invitation on her behalf (ch006-p01..p02). Locked FREL-001 models a crown-to-Duchess-household hand-off, and CHAR-fish-footman stays crown. His livery follows FAC-duchess-household emblem_visual (plainer, faded, less formal than Hearts crimson; inferred, as the source names no livery). This is an inference from the source and locked politics, not a new creative choice. (b) Accepted: mirror the appearance cards' concrete gender values.
